topics.label: Introduction and learning outcomes for cancer hallmarks
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture objectives, progression model, and framework for studying the hallmarks of cancer.

topics.label: Sustained proliferative signaling and oncogenic pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how mutations in growth factor receptors and intracellular signaling cascades drive uncontrolled proliferation and survival.

topics.label: Differentiation block in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how impaired terminal differentiation contributes to malignancy in hematopoietic and epithelial tissues.

topics.label: Evasion of apoptosis, replicative immortality, and p53 regulation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the mechanisms by which cancer cells avoid cell death, bypass senescence, and overcome p53-mediated stress responses.

topics.label: Metabolic reprogramming and oncometabolites in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe cancer-associated metabolic alterations, including aerobic glycolysis, metabolic rewiring, and Krebs cycle mutations.

topics.label: Induction of tumor angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic addresses how developing tumors stimulate new blood vessel growth to sustain oxygen and nutrient delivery.

topics.label: Mechanisms, dissemination, and genomics of metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the metastatic cascade, including vascular dissemination, biomarker monitoring, colonization dynamics, and genomic features.

topics.label: Lecture summary and concluding remarks
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding review of cancer hallmarks alongside closing administrative remarks.
